title: XPEL and Will Castro Return for Season 2 of 'Unique Academy USA,' Expanding Reach of Transformative Automotive Career Program
summary: XPEL, Inc. (Nasdaq: XPEL), a leading provider of protective films and coatings, and acclaimed car customizer and TV personality, Will Castro, today announced that Season 2 of ‘ Unique Academy USA’ will debut August 18th on the ROKU platform. The new season expands the program's reach, enrolling 15 new students – between the ages of 13 and 22 – in hands-on training designed to prepare the students for careers in the automotive technician and aftermarket industry. XPEL and acclaimed car customizer and TV personality, Will Castro, announced that Season 2 of ‘Unique Academy USA’ will debut on August 18th on ROKU. The program introduces inner-city youth to professional skills in automotive window film installation, paint protection film application and ceramic coating, at no cost to students.
